dedupe_keys.name: ccafs cmip5 delta method downscaled climate database

description: The CCAFS team publishes Delta Method bias-corrected CMIP5 climate scenarios at the World Data Center for Climate. The own WDCC DOI record is CC BY 4.0 and identifies monthly temperature, precipitation and bioclimatic grids across 35 climate models, four RCPs and four future periods. The article describes four grid resolutions from 30 arc-seconds to 10 arc-minutes, with regional tiles available from the roughly seven-terabyte collection. These grids can supply scenario forcing for infrastructure climate-adaptation or food and water service simulations. A caveat is that the delta method corrects long-term means against a historical baseline and should not be interpreted as a prediction of individual future storms. Model and RCP spread must be retained when comparing designs. Figshare DOI 5239615 is an XLSX index to the archive, not the deposited grids. I opened WDCC and DataCite metadata and read the article Data Records without downloading any grids or evaluating bias at a site. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
